notes.title: Myoubouh Catcher will release on the 7th January 2022 !
notes.notes:
Hello friends!

Myoubouh Catcher will be released tomorrow on Steam on January 7th 2022. The game was not easy to develop, but it is finally finished. We had a lot of fun working on this title and we are very happy with the result. 

We hope that as many people as possible can capture the 300+ fireflies in the game. If you have trouble finding them all you can ask us for help and we will try to help you. We hope to see many people taking a screenshot with the maximum number of fireflies on the counter! 

For those of you who are worried that you won't be able to catch everything, don't worry. The game design has been studied so that everyone can have the minimum required to continue the story until the end. Of course the most patient will be entitled to a little something extra. :) 

Thank you very much for your attention. 

Have a good game and a good year! =D
